contract.window_selection: all nonoverlapping windows from capture frame zero; retain partial and excluded denominators
contract.annotation_coordinate: nearest microsecond, positive half ties upward, then exact rational model frames; at most 0.5 microsecond quantization
contract.prefix: last four annotated beats strictly before window start; period is their total span divided by three
contract.half_phase: retain both alternating subsets of the continuation clock; never select the better one
contract.boundary: half-open window owns packet centers and ticks; no cross-window assignments; incomplete radius queries are boundary-censored, not interior misses
contract.eligibility: same complete 400-frame window and all five clocks for both sources; four-beat prefix and annotated span coverage required; report rather than truncate over-budget or cross-boundary packet support
contract.marks: original paired score-frame logits; beat sign is descriptive only, not a fitted gate or likelihood
contract.residuals: retain never/sometimes/always matched across all optimal assignments; annotation proximity is not acoustic truth
contract.cohort_scope: all 15 ARTBeaT and 25 RUBATO frozen calibration captures
